data.long_meaning: Jashmitha is a name derived from the Sanskrit word Yashaswini, which means 'Born from the goddess Yashaswini'. In Hindu mythology, Yashaswini is a goddess of fertility and prosperity. Jashmitha is believed to bring good fortune, prosperity, and fertility to those who bear this name. The name Jashmitha carries the meaning “Born from the goddess Yashaswini” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jashmitha usually hope their child will grow to embody born from the goddess yashaswini and live with faith, good character and purpose.
